d: Bangladesh has approved a 36 per cent wage hike for garment workers. But the protests are far from over. Workers say the increase is not enough to meet rising costs, and are continuing to block highways and clash with police. Factory shutdowns are disrupting an industry that drives more than 80 per cent of the country's export earnings. Why has the pay hike failed to calm the anger? And how much more could Bangladesh's garment industry lose? Palki Sharma explains the wage dispute threatening Bangladesh's economy.
